payload.notes: E1-T04 was added mid-sprint (not part of the original sprint 1 handoff) to add unit test coverage for E1-T01/T02/T03's existing functionality, following the human's decision that backend tickets now require unit tests going forward (CLAUDE.md 'Decisions Already Made' and 'Testing' sections updated accordingly). E1-T01 and E1-T02 are already merged; E1-T03 is being implemented to its original scope, without tests, by design. Only E1-T04 needs design work from you now — do not revisit design for E1-T01/T02/T03. In addition to E1-T04's technical design, please write an ADR documenting the process decision itself ('unit tests required for backend tickets going forward'), since this is a sprint-process/testing-policy decision, not just a code design decision for one ticket. The ADR is a separate artifact from E1-T04's design and both should go into the design PR per the contract's PR-hygiene rule (one design PR per sprint setup, together with plan.md/design.md/ADRs).
